product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental-practice management software that combines scheduling, billing and patient records for dental practices of any size.

pricing_page.notes: Publicly lists software-license, support and service fees.

named_customers.notes: Both practices are identified in testimonials describing their use of Open Dental.

employee_band.notes: The directory lists 201–500 employees, and the company blog reports over 300.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains product updates, practice-management advice and guest marketing content, rather than two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes multiple articles on setup, implementation, permissions and endpoints. Much of the comprehensive customer manual is restricted to customers on Support.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The actively hiring section lists Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: BetterDiagnostics and Pearl for AI image analysis; Bola AI for voice periodontal charting.
model_provider.notes: These are publicly named third-party native integrations, not a disclosed underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims HIPAA-aligned safeguards and HIPAA-compliant support data transfers; this is a compliance claim, not evidence of independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Funding profiles report no funding rounds and no known external funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No known outside funding or funding rounds are reported.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The actively hiring section lists support and daycare positions, with no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.1 became stable on August 6, 2026, within the requested window. Its highlights include ODTouch 25, custom insurance-history categories and HTML billing emails.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP appointment or departure could be verified. Available leadership listings lack start dates or gate part of the roster, so they do not establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed official integration pages name no CRM or sales-and-marketing system; their named integrations concern clinical tools, payments, claims and related dental services.
